# TraceFork

> Interactive inspection tree for comparing, aligning, and diffing same-task GUI-agent, browser-agent, and computer-use execution trajectories (EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations).

- Live Web App: https://yuzhang-zhong.github.io/TraceFork/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/yuzhang-zhong/TraceFork
- Authors: Yuzhang Zhong, Stephen Xia

## Capabilities
- Deterministic step alignment and divergence scoring across two or more runs of the same GUI/web agent task.
- Interactive fork/rejoin inspection tree with action nodes, state summaries, and screenshot evidence.
- Built-in WebArena / VisualWebArena static trajectory library plus support for pasted raw logs, HTML excerpts, and normalized JSON traces.
- Supports human-vs-model, model-vs-model, prompt-variant, and success-vs-failure trajectory debugging.
